privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how PriceWatch collects, uses, and protects your personal data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection law.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
items: Email address (upon registration)
Password (hashed via bcrypt, never stored in plaintext)
Google ID (if using Google OAuth sign-in)
Tracked product URLs and target prices
Price history records
Notification preferences

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
items: Creating and managing your user account
Automatic monitoring of your products' prices
Sending email alerts when prices drop
Sending webhook notifications (if configured)
Improving the service

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: Processing is based on the performance of the contract (Terms of Service) you accept upon registration, and on your consent for marketing communications.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.content: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. It is deleted within 30 days of account deletion.

subprocessors.title: 6. Sub-processors
items: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) — transactional email delivery
Google LLC — OAuth authentication (if you use "Sign in with Google")

rights.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access to your data
Right to rectification
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Right to data portability
Right to object to processing
rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, go to your Settings or contact us at:

security.title: 8. Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data: password hashing, JWT tokens, HTTPS connections, restricted database access.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.content: PriceWatch uses your browser's localStorage to maintain your login session (JWT tokens). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.content: For any questions about this policy, contact us at:

object.title: 1. Purpose
object.content: PriceWatch is an online service that monitors product prices on French e-commerce sites and sends alerts when prices drop. These Terms of Service govern access to and use of the service.

acceptance.title: 2. Acceptance
acceptance.content: By creating an account, you accept these Terms of Service in their entirety. If you do not accept these terms, you may not use the service.

account.title: 3. User Account
items: You must provide a valid email address upon registration.
You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
You agree not to create multiple accounts or impersonate others.
We reserve the right to suspend or delete any account in cases of misuse.

service.title: 4. Service Description and Limitations
items: PriceWatch automatically monitors prices at defined intervals.
Prices displayed come from third-party sites; PriceWatch does not guarantee real-time accuracy.
The service may be temporarily unavailable for maintenance.
Some sites may block scraping; PriceWatch cannot guarantee monitoring of all products.
PriceWatch is not a marketplace and does not make any purchases on your behalf.

usage.title: 5. Acceptable Use
usage.content: You agree to use the service lawfully and not to attempt to overload, hack, or otherwise disrupt the service.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual Property
ip.content: The source code, design, and trademarks of PriceWatch are the property of the publisher. Price data belongs to the respective source sites.

liability.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: PriceWatch is provided "as is". The publisher cannot be held liable for purchase decisions made based on displayed information, nor for service interruptions.

termination.title: 8. Termination
termination.content: You may delete your account at any time from your Settings. The publisher may terminate your access in the event of a breach of these Terms.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.content: These Terms may be amended. You will be notified by email of any material changes.

law.title: 10. Governing Law
law.content: These Terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, French courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: All content on this site (texts, source code, images, trademarks) is protected by intellectual property law. Any partial or full reproduction without written permission is prohibited.

data.title: Personal Data
data.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. See our Privacy Policy for more information.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: This site uses localStorage to maintain your session. No advertising cookies are used.

about.title: About PriceWatch
about.subtitle: Your assistant to never miss a great deal
about.description: PriceWatch is a price monitoring application that lets you automatically track price changes on major French e-commerce sites and receive an alert as soon as the price of your product drops below your target threshold.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
steps: Add the URL of a product you want to track and set your target price.
PriceWatch automatically checks the price at the frequency you choose (every 6h, 12h, or 24h).
As soon as the price drops below your threshold, you receive an alert by email or webhook.

tech.title: Technology
tech.content: PriceWatch is built with Python/FastAPI on the backend, React/TypeScript on the frontend, and PostgreSQL for the database. Scraping uses BeautifulSoup and Playwright.

contact.content: For any questions or suggestions, contact us at:

gdpr.title: My Data (GDPR)
gdpr.description: Under GDPR, you can export or delete all your personal data.
gdpr.exportDescription: Download a JSON file containing all your data: account, tracked products, price history, and preferences.
gdpr.deleteDescription: Account deletion is permanent. All your data (products, history, preferences) will be erased.

deleteModal.title: Confirm deletion
deleteModal.warning: This action is irreversible. All your data will be permanently deleted.
deleteModal.googleNote: Your account is linked to Google. No password required.
